Toe points directly toward screen bottom, knee and ankle aligned with that straight forward axis, not sideways. Keep the foot in its existing lane and gently flex its knee. Rear anatomical RIGHT leg remains curled behind airborne in viewer-left lane, toe also straight forward. Image5 illustrates left-foot contact only. Preserve current head/hair/face, torso, costume, right-hand FIVE cards, left-hand bell and complete arm connections. Exact existing camera and overall proportions, no zoom. Output one full1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite. Do not add ground art or shadows. No global rescale or recenter.
